Imperial Court — Luxury Wedding Venue, Mumbai

Imperial Court is a luxury banquet and convention venue in Mumbai with a grand
ballroom (capacity ~800), a sea-facing terrace, and premium in-house services.
It positions itself at the high end of the city wedding market.

The ballroom-plus-terrace package starts at ₹12,00,000 per day, including
premium lighting, valet, and a dedicated event team. Catering is exclusively
in-house with a multi-cuisine luxury menu.

Contact: +91 98200 80045 · weddings@imperialcourt.example
Location: Worli, Mumbai, Maharashtra
Rating: 4.7 / 5 (96 reviews)

What couples say:
"The sea-facing terrace at sunset was absolutely stunning."
"White-glove service from start to finish."
"Expensive, but a genuinely luxurious experience."

Imperial Court caters to premium city weddings and provides an end-to-end event
team, making it a frequent shortlist pick for high-budget Mumbai celebrations.
